text: {"lessons":["I should judge decisions by my overall account and ability to fund retirement, rather than by whether an individual sale shows a gain or loss.","After selling Stock D at a steep loss and Stock E at gains, I should avoid reacting to cost basis or recent price moves alone; reassess calmly before trading.","My account rose gradually while I made no trades in later periods, reinforcing that frequent trading is not necessary; I should favor a cautious, balanced approach that limits large swings."]}
